Bill.BriefDescription: Repealing provisions concerning body gripping traps.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to body gripping traps; repealing RCW 77.15.192,77.15.194, 77.15.196, and 77.15.198; repealing 2001 c 1 s 1(uncodified); and repealing 2001 c 1 s 6 (uncodified).
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The following acts or parts of acts are eachrepealed: RCW 77.15.192 (Definitions) and 2001 c 1 s 2; RCW 77.15.194 (Unlawful traps) and 2001 c 1 s 3; RCW 77.15.196 (Unlawful poison) and 2001 c 1 s 4; RCW 77.15.198 (Violation of RCW 77.15.194 or 77.15.196Penalty) and 2001 c 1 s 5; 2001 c 1 s 1 (uncodified); and 2001 c 1 s 6 (uncodified).
